verdict_reason: Fix #3 before merging: failed ancestor workspace discovery can widen formatting to the whole workspace and makes behavior depend on target order. All planned implementation units have corresponding work; R8/R9 retain this P2 edge-case defect. Two documented skill scenarios remain unexecuted.
intent: Add same-workspace multiple-target formatting with complete preflight before writes. Integrate compatible CLI checking and scoped formatting into writer and read-only evaluator, preserving independent design review, accurate captured-revision evidence, and offline fallback.

evidence: packages/core/src/workspace.ts:73-87 -- When no ancestor configuration exists, discovery returns currentDirectory as root and SIGIL_CONFIG_NOT_FOUND without a config; formatSources compares only that fallback root.
packages/cli/src/core-adapter.ts:193-199 -- A directory matches every workspace file whose path starts with the target prefix.
packages/cli/_module.sigil:489-490 -- Missing, excluded, unmatched, or foreign-workspace targets abort the whole invocation with exit code 3 before any write.

Read-only reproduction at 29f9ef355a57a95041eeb5f2dd81702ebc30a0b2 using Deno 2.9.4 and an in-memory writable filesystem: configuration only at /work; cwd /work; two noncanonical valid sources /work/a.sigil and /work/b.sigil. formatSources(["a.sigil", ".."], undefined, false) returned both files formatted, no diagnostics, and replacement calls for both files. Reversing the targets threw "No Sigil source matched /." with zero replacement calls. No real project files were written.
git diff base 5b6aac9..29f9ef3 adds the per-target discovery guard; the base CLI rejected more than one formatting target.
findings.suggested_fix: Reject unsuccessful per-target workspace discovery before comparing roots, while preserving the documented explicit-root ancestor-selection exemption. Add both argument orders with a valid file plus an ancestor target and assert failure before any replacements; cover --check as well.
findings.title: Out-of-workspace ancestor target silently formats whole workspace
findings.why_it_matters: With the working directory at the configured workspace root and no configuration above it, adding an ancestor directory after a valid file bypasses failed workspace discovery. The invocation formats every included workspace source, while reversing the same targets fails without writes. This violates complete target preflight and order-independent selection.
findings.validation_reason: At reviewed SHA 29f9ef3 under Deno 2.9.4, the reachable precondition of cwd /work with configuration only at /work and targets ["a.sigil", ".."] caused packages/core/src/workspace.ts:73-84 to return fallback root /work after failed ancestor discovery, allowing packages/cli/src/core-adapter.ts:193-215 to select and, with check=false, replace both workspace files despite the abort-before-write contract at packages/cli/_module.sigil:489-491, while reversed target order rejected with no writes; the multi-target diff from 5b6aac9 introduced this order-dependent path.

residual_risks: Filesystem replacement failure during a batch can leave an already-written subset formatted; packages/cli/spec.md:222 and packages/cli/_module.sigil:491 explicitly exclude rollback. Target and semantic preflight does not establish transactionality for I/O failures.

Mixed filesystem aliases such as macOS /tmp and /private/tmp can fail target matching despite identifying the same physical workspace. The smoke observations document this limit and use canonical paths; alias equivalence is not claimed.

testing_gaps.title: Single-target compatibility fallback lacks an executed test
testing_gaps.why_it_matters: A supported older CLI can expose only single-target formatting, so a writer or evaluator must split commands without broadening the authorized file set and must disclose interdependent repairs it cannot complete. That branch currently has no observed agent run, leaving the workflow able to issue an unsupported batch command, widen scope to a directory, or misreport mechanical coverage despite the new compatibility promise.
